title: 第3章 仙人日常修枝松土第4章 练气四层喜获灵田
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
陈景安明白他爹这话的意思。
六叔拜入了仙门，他在用度上会比族里宽裕不少。
而陈景安作为穿越者。
在知道了这是一个修仙世界，而他六叔又是家族难得的天才以后，陈景安自然就有意与之打好关系。
六叔尚未成家。
他因着几次六叔回家时的示好，顺理成章成了族里与六叔最合拍的小辈。
陈景安承认自己最开始是带着目的交好的。
可十几年下来，这利益也早就被亲情给消去了大半。
之所以没敢打包票，那是因为陈景安要脸。
平心而论，他当然还是希望六叔能资助自己一点，好让他有机会稍微改变现状。
如今当了爹，儿子又有灵根。
他们爷俩总不能一辈子以吐纳为生吧！
儿子还小，没法吸血。
所以只能自己这个当爹的先想办法奋斗了。
六叔曾经说过，要是自己有儿子了，他会送上一份贺礼来着，这话陈景安可一直记着呢！
他爹平时看着与世无争，但自家二哥能在家族控制的三班衙役里，稳坐油水最足的“民壮”
都统，这就证明了他老人家的段位也不低。
陈景安能想到的，他爹当然也能想到。
父子二人对视一眼，点到为止。
一旁的陈母也故作不在意，这愣是让竖起耳朵偷听的陈景亮满脑子浆糊，打死都想不到自家父亲与三哥竟然玩得这么脏。

随后，陈景安拜别了二老。
他走到自家后院，将家族配给他的一匹“妖马”
给牵了出来。
这是一种由妖物与骏马交配生出的代步之物，在脚力上不弱于那些所谓的千里马，缺陷在于只有练气修士方能驯服。
正常来说，一匹纯正的妖马，即“妖二代”
，就需要两块灵石才能买到一匹。
可如果是妖马之子，即“妖三代”
，价格减半，能力也一定程度衰减。
而陈景安分到的这匹妖马，属于妖四代，一块灵石能买两匹。
这已经属于套马的极限了，没法再往下套了。
陈景安给自家的这匹妖马取了名，就叫“五角”
，因为它不值一块。
面前的五角，其实已经是陈景安五分之一的家当了。
他堂堂练气三层的修士，全身上下加起来，也就两块半灵石的个人资产。
content_en:
Chen Jingan understood what his father meant.
If Uncle Six joins the Immortal Sect, he will be much more generous than the rest of the clan in terms of expenses.
And Chen Jingan is a time traveler.
After knowing that this was a world of immortal cultivation and that his sixth uncle was a rare genius in the family, Chen Jingan naturally intended to have a good relationship with him.
Uncle Six has not yet married.
Due to Uncle Six's goodwill when he returned home several times, he naturally became the younger member of the clan who was most in tune with Uncle Six.
Chen Jingan admitted that he made friends with purpose in the beginning.
But after more than ten years, most of this benefit has been eliminated by family ties.
The reason why he didn't dare to guarantee it was because Chen Jingan wanted to lose face.
To be fair, of course he still hopes that Uncle Liu can help him a little so that he can have a chance to change the status quo a little.
Now that he is a father, his son has spiritual roots.
The two of them can't make a living by spitting out food all their lives!
My son is still young and cannot suck blood.
So I, as a father, can only find a way to struggle first.
Uncle Liu once said that if he had a son, he would give him a gift. Chen Jingan would always remember this!
His father usually seems to be aloof from the world, but his second brother is able to sit firmly in the most lucrative "people's stronghold" in the third class of government offices controlled by the family.
Dutong, this proves that his rank is not low.
Of course, what Chen Jingan can think of, his father can also think of.
The father and son looked at each other and nodded.
Chen's mother on the side also pretended not to care. This made Chen Jingliang, who was eavesdropping with his ears pricked up, so confused that he never imagined that his father and third brother were playing so dirty.
Afterwards, Chen Jingan said goodbye to his two elders.
He went to his backyard and bought a "demon horse" assigned to him by his family.
He was led out.
This is a kind of walking creature that is born from the mating of a monster and a horse. It is not weaker than those so-called thousand-mile horses in terms of leg strength. The disadvantage is that only Qi-training monks can tame it.
Normally, a pure demon horse is the "demon second generation"
, it takes two spiritual stones to buy one.
But if he is the son of a demon horse, he will be the "third generation of demon"
, the price is halved, and the capabilities are also reduced to a certain extent.
The demon horse Chen Jingan was assigned belonged to the fourth generation of demons, and one spirit stone could buy two of them.
This is already the limit of horse roping, and there is no way to do it any further.
Chen Jingan named his monster horse "Five Jiao"
, because it's not worth a piece.
The five cents in front of him were actually one-fifth of Chen Jingan's property.
He is a dignified monk at the third level of Qi training, and his whole body combined has only two and a half spiritual stones as personal assets.
